response.sql: WITH sentiment_transaction_trader AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), pair_averages AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt FROM sentiment_transaction_trader WHERE optvolrt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref, tradekind), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) as overall_avg FROM pair_averages), pair_deviations AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_optvolrt, (p.avg_optvolrt - o.overall_avg) as deviation FROM pair_averages p CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), type_avg_deviation AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation FROM pair_deviations GROUP BY tradekind), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT pd.transref, pd.tradekind, pd.avg_optvolrt, pd.deviation, (pd.deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation) as excess FROM pair_deviations pd INNER JOIN type_avg_deviation tad ON pd.tradekind = tad.tradekind WHERE pd.deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM filtered_pairs GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind
